subject.title: feat(ios): Liquid Glass UI, Action Button & Dynamic Island

question: Should OpenClaw accept a native iOS Action Button/AppIntent path into Talk Mode now, or fold that work into the broader Siri/AppIntent product issue?
rationale: The remaining unique value is a new iOS platform shortcut and Live Activity behavior; automation can identify the rebase defects, but a maintainer needs to decide the product scope and whether to rescue this stale branch.

options.title: Rebase and narrow to Talk Mode intent
options.body: Keep this PR open only if it is rebased onto current RootTabs and limited to the approved Action Button/Talk Mode behavior plus required proof.

options.title: Fold into AppIntent issue
options.body: Treat the AppIntent direction as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/47584 and pause this branch until that product and security scope is settled.

options.title: Request a fresh PR
options.body: Close or pause this stale branch and ask for a new minimal PR that starts from current main and preserves the current iOS architecture.

recommendation.title: Rebase and narrow to Talk Mode intent
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if it is rebased onto current RootTabs and limited to the approved Action Button/Talk Mode behavior plus required proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The product and rebase choice most directly overlaps the current RootTabs/Liquid Glass iOS direction.
